id: P3-M1 prospective empirical-IF / standardized residual validation

scope.estimator: native mirt1.2.0 MAP GH61 max500 tol1e-4 default priors

methods.3PL: A-emp: unchanged native S-X2 with full observed penalized marginal-equation Jacobian, empirical frequency-weighted centered residual IF covariance, noncentral generalized chi-square tail including deterministic null-space shift
methods.4PL: MAP IF-standardized residual Q: N(u-null_mean)'Sigma^-1(u-null_mean), rank chi-square; separately named, inspired by Han et al., NOT ordinary S-X2 and NOT an asserted direct transfer of ML theory

derivative: G=-sum empirical score frequencies*d conditional_j(score)/d eta; A=-sum phat*d2log p_pattern - Hprior/N. IF=h+score A^-T G^T. All coordinates physical joint (a,b,c[,d]); no parameterwise covariance; prior curvature only in A. Sigma=sum phat psi psi'-mean_psi mean_psi'. Full conditional-probability derivative from GH41 pattern likelihoods; native estimation likelihood GH61. Null mean=model E[h]+G A^-1 gradprior/N. Data-realized native pooling retained, selection assessed in independent MC.

numerics.bread: symmetric positive definite, condition <=1e10; no pseudoinverse; observed vs expected bread compared
numerics.bounds: native runtime bounds inspected; within1e-6 active-bound distance -> refusal
numerics.rank: whitened residual covariance eigenvalues >1e-10*max retained; materially negative eigenvalues below -1e-10*max -> refuse; rank<3 -> refuse; deterministic projected mean in discarded space retained in generalized chi-square reference
numerics.derivative_tests: analytic score and observed Hessian vs centered differences at steps1e-5/5e-6; full residual-functional IF via independent re-solve; original S-X2 <=1e-8 native. Gaussian tail against independent characteristic-function inversion and scipy chi2/ncx2
numerics.standardized: Q is covariance-standardized, not S-X2; null-space observed residual must agree with deterministic mean to numerical error, otherwise refuse

DGP.registered_alternative_warning: Historical code draws item1 latent ability independently from other items using seed+[1]; this is not simply doubled slope on a shared latent trait. Preserve actual historical alternative unchanged, report discrepancy; no easier substitute.

gates.non_evaluable_null_policy: count as rejection for every failed item; power failures count as non-detection
gates.completion: all planned records, duplicate/missing seeds forbidden

stopping.confirmation: no interim acceptance; no rejection just because interim bound exceeds final gate; only technical failure/deadline or logically impossible final acceptance even with all remaining successes
stopping.pilot: development only, never certified; mathematical/technical failure stops before confirmation; only prospective primary methods eligible

reference.title: The Standardized S-X2 Statistic for Assessing Item Fit
reference.warning: Published unpenalized ML covariance standardization motivates but does not validate native MAP adaptation.

execution: No P1/P2 simulations, no bootstrap retries, cache native fit per dataset shared across candidates. One BLAS thread, bounded workers, checkpoint every record. Archive raw decisions, seeds/hashes, full diagnostics and failures. Production promotion only after every model-specific confirmation gate passes.
